skills.name: reading-a-market-read
skills.description: Interpret an Idea Launch market read correctly — the validation score, band, confidence, and recommended next move — and report it without overstating what a single ad test proves. Use when the user asks how their Idea Launch test went, what a validation score or band means, whether a result is good, whether to build or keep testing, or why a run is not live yet.
headings: Reading an Idea Launch market read
Read the score and the confidence together
Check what the read is based on
Lead with the move, not the numbers
A run that is not live yet
Language
Common misreads

skills.name: setting-up-an-idea-test
skills.description: Set up an Idea Launch test well — write a brief specific enough to target against, generate ad creative, and check every gate before the user spends an Ad Run. Use when the user wants to validate a product idea, test whether something is worth building, get ads running for a product they already shipped, or asks what is blocking their Idea Launch test from starting.
